# Microsoft Power Pages documentation
Create external-facing websites; users sign in with a variety of identities, create/view Dataverse data,
or browse anonymously.

## Getting started
- Introducing Power Pages, capabilities, create/manage sites, security, architecture/security papers, community

## Tutorials
- Overview, Design home page, Set up brand kit, Create page with list, Create page with simple form,
  Configure site authentication

## Design and build
- Use the new design studio, Pages workspace, Styling workspace, Templates, Portal Management app,
  VS Code and Power Platform CLI, Plan your project

## AI and Copilot
- AI-powered and Copilot features overview
- Create AI-generated form using Copilot
- Add AI-generated text using Copilot
- Enable agent in your site
- Force Bing webmaster to index your site

## Connect to Dataverse
- What is Dataverse, Use the data workspace, Add lists, Add basic/multistep forms, Table permissions,
  Create/update/view Dataverse information

## Customize and extend
- Liquid, Web templates, Portals web API, Code components, Configure Power Automate cloud flows, Advanced config

## Security / Go live / Administer and monitor
- Security overview, authentication, web roles, table permissions
- Go live checklist, licensing, ALM
- Portals admin center, troubleshooting/diagnostics, maintain/update, review consumption
